services.value: EMSL provides a wide range of lab services, including environmental testing (e.g., asbestos, indoor air quality, industrial hygiene, chemical analysis, fire and smoke, radiochemistry) and microbiology/pathogen testing (e.g., FDA Detain Microbiology Pathogens, PCR, whole genome sequencing). The site also lists consumer products testing and materials testing such as metals, mechanical testing, and failure analysis.
